text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is that true?! Biwa Hayahide's
quitting
running because of her injury
from the Tenno Sho
last fall?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: That's what I heard. Sigh... It's a real shame. I loved watching Hayahide run.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No kidding. I really wanted to see her
face off
against Brian too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Say, Brian. How about a scrimmage?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the day I can face
off
against you as a rival. I still can't do
the distance of a regular race, but
perhaps if it was shor—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian, just keep on running ahead. Don't
look
back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Why'd she say it wasn't possible back
then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What did she mean by "don't look
back"?!

Narita Brian tackles her training with a
ghastly
vigor in preparation for her next
big race—the
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Gasp... Huff... Gasp... Huff

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff... One more time... Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Narita Brian! Can I get an interview?
Even just
a few words will do!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Just excuse me for a few seconds! With
Biwa Hayahide's return to the Twinkle
Series being
ruled hopeless, what do
you—
choice_data_list: We're in the middle of training ri...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Cut it out.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Stop talking about my sister!

The air goes ice cold in an instant. Her
voice is
filled with an astonishing anger.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh!

I spare one last glance for the reporter,
whose
face is pale and stricken, and
then run after
Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch! What do you do when your dream
turns out
to be an illusion you can never
catch?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
All these idiots blabbing nonsense about
my
sister—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the outburst.
I'll go back to the
training
track later.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just leave me alone for now. Go on and
get out
of here.

First there was the news after the
autumn Tenno
Sho a few days ago. And
now, the reporter's
questions today...

Narita Brian seems to have a
disproportionately strong reaction
whenever her sister, Biwa
Hayahide, is
brought up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Stop!
choice_data_list: Are you talking about your older s...
Are you talking about your older s...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Just... stop talking about her. Please.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: My sister...

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hurry up, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: She was always ahead of me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to give up on that race so
easily!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Just leave me alone already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I get it. Even without my sister,
there are still
hordes of strong opponents to face
in the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
This is a place where only the most
dauntless
remain, after all. It's hardly
surprising that some
would be cast aside.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Even if it's Sis...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...She's not coming back. That's the
reality of it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Facts and feelings are two differe...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The thought of hurting someone else just
by
existing is... scary, sad, and really
awful. But...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But I don't want to give up on running...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You were always up ahead, out of reach.
Then,
before I knew it, it was over. ...But
then again,
this is what usually happens.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But I'll catch up for sure next time!
The racer called the Sable Assassin...

And the one that everyone thinks can't
win.

Both have feelings that differ from the
reality that
others see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: There are only strong girls in the...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: I think your sister feels the same...
I'm sure your big sister feels tha...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Of course she's strong! She's my sister!

In an effort not to disturb her, I gently
close my
eyes and turn the other way.

But I can hear her choked sobs behind
me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hayahide? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I'm wondering if she's still doing her
best right
now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. But we're not about to lose either!
Are you
ready, Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You bet! Hey, Doc!

text_block_list.name: Physical Therapist
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sorry to keep you waiting! Today's
rehab is
going to be especially difficult.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on it!

text_block_list.name: Physical Therapist
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, your spirits haven't fallen at all
since last
year. You're both very
impressive.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. I want to get back to the
Twinkle Series
as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...There's no need to waste time worrying
over
me. I'm Narita Brian's big sis, after
all.
